import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = in.nextLong();
        long m = in.nextLong();
        long mod = in.nextLong();

        int maxVal = (int) Math.max(n, m);
        long[] fac = new long[maxVal + 1];
        long[] inv = new long[maxVal + 1];
        int[] bit = new int[(int) n + 1];

        fac[0] = fac[1] = 1;
        inv[0] = inv[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= maxVal; i++) {
            long r = mod / i;
            long x = mod - i * r;
            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % mod;
            inv[i] = (mod - r * inv[(int) x] % mod) % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= maxVal; i++) {
            inv[i] = inv[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod;
        }

        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            ans = ans * m % mod;
        }

        bit[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            bit[i] = bit[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(ans);
            return;
        }

        long[][] dp = new long[30][(int) n + 1];
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        int pop = bit[(int) n];
        int limit = Math.min(pop, (int) m);
        for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (dp[i][j] == 0) continue;
                int x = (int) n ^ j;
                for (int k = x; k > j; k = (k - 1) & x) {
                    int r = k | j;
                    dp[i + 1][r] = (dp[i + 1][r] + dp[i][j] * inv[k] % mod) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        int limit2 = Math.min((int) m, pop);
        for (int i = 1; i <= limit2; i++) {
            long term = dp[i][(int) n];
            term = term * fac[(int) m] % mod;
            term = term * inv[(int) m - i] % mod;
            term = term * fac[(int) n] % mod;
            ans = (ans - term) % mod;
        }
        ans = (mod + ans % mod) % mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
